name: Integration qualification
intervention: runtime and upload-path tracing at frozen executable revisions
implementation_gate: regenerated source/config/image manifest; mount identity; producer and conditional durable PUT; persisted layout
weakening_outcome: unmatched path or absent effective treatment blocks that causal comparison

name: Agent workload characterization
intervention: instrumented tasks stratified by immutable S identity
primary_metrics: within-S read overlap; mutation footprint; request distributions
implementation_gate: replay-capable traces; baseline/task manifests; tool spans; grading
weakening_outcome: low sharing or large mutations weaken workload premise

name: Locality and reuse
intervention: within-S task pairs and fixed query sessions; declared K and lifetime T
baseline_controls: singleton groups; random and inode-order controls
primary_metrics: Jaccard; weighted overlap; reuse distance; page reuse; K/T distribution
implementation_gate: identical base/subtree/dependency identities; explicit reuse unit and retention policy
weakening_outcome: mostly singleton S groups; low overlap or no page reuse

name: Workspace provisioning
intervention: baseline size and simultaneous-workspace sweeps; prepositioned/cold-stage
baseline_controls: copy/reflink/overlay; strongest compatible mature lower+upper; matched runtime controls
primary_metrics: ready latency; first tool; materialized metadata; bytes
implementation_gate: same initial tree and declared S groups; matched completion/resource contracts
weakening_outcome: local overlay or lazy lower equal/better; startup scales with baseline

name: Mutation and churn
intervention: mutation and namespace/data churn under frozen arrival and retention policies
baseline_controls: same-path materialized lower; local supported contracts
primary_metrics: private bytes; tombstones; durable latency; retained byte-seconds; reclamation debt
implementation_gate: actual ownership/cleanup support; report unfinished lifecycle at cutoff
weakening_outcome: cost approaches replication or cleanup grows unbounded

name: Packed access layout
baseline_controls: identical records and cache budget; separate standalone and workspace-lower paths
primary_metrics: lower-KV calls; object counts; bytes; P50/P99
implementation_gate: lower adapters; directory capacity; separate upper/control counters
weakening_outcome: index/overfetch cost removes benefit or lower-KV fallback persists

name: Cache and cold state
intervention: index/meta/data warm states; supported cache sweeps
baseline_controls: equal memory and explicit server cache state
primary_metrics: miss rate; remote bytes; cold and warm latency
implementation_gate: readonly Packed rejects payload cache; new adapter required for that sweep

name: Snapshot construction amortization
intervention: K reuse and actual version lifetime T; rebuild/churn; fixed tau_ret policy
baseline_controls: mutable lower; immutable sorted-KV; mature lower+upper with matched retention
primary_metrics: build/publish/use/retain/reclaim cost by unit; byte-seconds; peak RAM; separate makespan
implementation_gate: validated publication; fixed per-path reuse unit; shared work charged once; censored debt recorded
weakening_outcome: net savings nonpositive in measured K/T range or lifecycle incomplete

name: (B,q) physical mechanism
intervention: B fixed/default/auto; eligible q-selector; range alignment
baseline_controls: content-equivalent new object sets; same d/p
primary_metrics: persisted (B,q); data/parity pread bytes; EC/checksum CPU
implementation_gate: effective layout audit; identical persisted (B,q) is no-treatment; physical counters
weakening_outcome: q gate leaves layout unchanged or extra work offsets reads

name: Client and layout causality
baseline_controls: same objects within each persisted layout
implementation_gate: separate policy controls; retain upper integrity; new objects for q variants
weakening_outcome: gain is entirely caching/coalescing or upper still fetches whole object

name: Write and repair trade-off
implementation_gate: durability markers; q-aware repair and corruption validation

name: Composition
intervention: legal optional mechanisms under one runtime; factorial or nested effects
baseline_controls: best supported proper subset internally; strongest external baseline at matched semantics/resources
primary_metrics: incremental combined gain; separate external advantage; per-metric cost; secondary interactions
implementation_gate: same-runtime internal controls; E00; valid cells; frozen contrasts/quality constraints
weakening_outcome: no incremental gain over simpler subsets or unacceptable cost/quality tradeoff; zero interaction alone is not a falsifier

name: Deterministic replay
primary_metrics: task time; critical path; tree/output verification
implementation_gate: initial state, path/handle mapping, payload and ordering
weakening_outcome: trace cannot replay or improvements vanish with fixed work

name: Live multi-agent execution
intervention: full 20-task or 60-task batches; 3 systems; initially 3 independent batches/system
baseline_controls: frozen strongest compatible mature lower+upper and further external system; same batch manifest
primary_metrics: correct completions/all assigned; censored batch makespan; resources; retention cost
implementation_gate: 180/540 task-execution budgets for one condition; batch n from pilot; paired resets; frozen m/deadline/retention; mount proof
weakening_outcome: no end-to-end gain; quality regressions; insufficient independent batches limit inference

name: Semantics and isolation
primary_metrics: mismatches; stale bytes; cross-view visibility; errors
implementation_gate: explicit support matrix and operation oracle

name: Failure and compatibility
baseline_controls: old/new persisted layouts and fail-closed oracle
primary_metrics: legal state; detection; recovery time; garbage
implementation_gate: reopen/takeover extension before runtime recovery claims
weakening_outcome: incomplete object published; integrity bypass; unsafe GC

name: Long-run bounds and interference
intervention: candidate 2h protocol extended to cache/cleanup cycles and declared retention
baseline_controls: steady state and isolated maintenance phases
primary_metrics: P99 windows; RSS; descriptors; owners; pending uploads; retained byte-seconds; GC lag
implementation_gate: actual lifecycle/GC support; owner/dir limits; no completed-lifecycle claim for residual debt
